items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: it belongs to, uh, old man Moran

ctx.x: Wallace, I see. What kind of club was that you played for?

It was a, it was a, it was a, it was a, it was a, a ballroom, a ballroom downstairs, and a dance hall upstairs, you see? Whose place was it? It's in reserve, it's, it belongs to, uh, old man Moran. Moran. Uh-huh, yeah.
And is it still there? Yeah, the club's still there. I'd like to get a picture of you in front of it somehow. Yeah, it's still there, mm-hmm.
